title: Jayo Filament 11kg $63.99 + $10 Delivery ($0 to Select Areas) @ Jiawei-3dtech eBay (Excludes NT)
body:
Deal: Jayo Filament 11kg $63.99 + $10 Delivery ($0 to Select Areas) @ Jiawei-3dtech eBay (Excludes NT)

[3dprintdeals] How cheap is the marble cement grey!
I must resist. I got my agent to load up all my spools into Spoolman and i'm at 96!…
[3dprintdeals] ah cement grey is gone now, only the light cyan marble left.
[skid] Same here. Must resist. 11kg of TPU would take 2 lifetimes to go through. But so cheap
[bcYield] Bought 30kg of these at around $11/kg in 2024 and thought they were cheap. Only used one recently so far…
[Orrelljet] If only we could mix filaments at that price!
[3dprintdeals] PLA+ 2.0 Yellow is a pretty close match to Lego.
[3dprintdeals] it's red and glows in the dark
abrasive if you're printing out 11kg worth, use a hardened nozzle & gears
[Lilqueotie] If you want to mix and match colours, the same code applies to their usual buy 10 pay for 6 deal ( https://www.ebay.com.au/itm/135014927221 )
A bunch on there for $14.99 a roll before the discounts, similar to the list in OPs post. Works out to $7.20 a roll
[3dprintdeals] Yep, the spreadsheet is updated in that deal too.
[Towels] If it was up to me thise dirty Northern Territorians wouldn’t get anything wat so ever!
[Wontons] I bought 11 kg of the Cherry Wood, thinking it was wood-coloured rather than wood fibre…
Anyone have any experiences on JAYO Wood PLA in the AMS? TIA
[3dprintdeals] Will be find
Its more wood powder than fibres
[Wontons] Sweet - figured I'd be okay since I have AMS first feeder funnel PTFE tubing. Cheers!
[Xheis] That's a wrap I think - pretty sure all the good stock is sold.
[3dprintdeals] Stock is still available in the mixed buy listing, only a little more at $7.20
[bcYield] Need a Bambu Lab AMS deal to pair with these for multi colour printing.
Btw anything interesting or useful for me to print?
[bigmicka] Depending on your model and firmware, get a BMCU from aliexpress.
Adds ams features for 1/4 the price.
[bcYield] Would it be a 3rd party and wokring well similar to the original? I'm still new to these things.
[bigmicka] If you are looking for black or white pla or pla+
Jiawei have 5kg spools for $46.
If you buy 2 or more it comes down to $43.70.
After SAVE20CBT 10KG is $70.
https://ebay.io/m/bnwT3P
[iLikePizza] Thanks but damn doesnt ship to WA either
[Tanvry] wow price is even cheaper than aliexpress
[iLikePizza] You buy filament on Ali?
How much typically per roll
[iLikePizza] Seller doesnt ship to my area.
WA nooooooo
[Mikael] Great, saved me some money and space in shed lol.
[MattyD] Got excited. But every link I clicked was oos. Missed the boat I guess.
[3dprintdeals] Check the mixed buy listing, a little more at $7.20
[Nukkels] Still available at the cheap prices in the mixed listing:
PLA variants - Clear blue, clear green, clear yellow, clear, lemon yellow (meta), cherry red (meta), luminous red, yellow (2.0), chocolate (HS Matte), lemon yellow (HS Matte), mint green (HS Matte)
[Jimmil44] 11kg of clear PLA for $72 delivered. Incredible. Cheers op.
[theguyrules] Epic deal. I am glad I didn’t jump on the initial bulk deal when this was posted as the mix and match for a bit more suited me better
Excited to finally try TPU
